description: Offload coding/text tasks to a local LLM (Ollama) to save Claude API tokens. Use for code generation, refactoring, formatting, boilerplate, and other routine tasks.

category.description: Task category for automatic model selection (optional). Ignored if model is specified.

context.description: Additional context such as file content or specifications (optional, max 100000 chars)

model.description: Override the Ollama model to use (optional). Takes precedence over category-based selection.

task.description: The task to perform (required, max 50000 chars)

name: offload_work
